name: metric_triangle_single_shortcut
why: d(f,t)=1 > d(f,x)+d(x,t)=1/4+1/4; only ordered triples (f,x,t),(t,x,f) fail. Symmetric, identity and separation hold; loss table over {f,t} unchanged.

name: metric_asymmetric_triangle_tight
why: d(f,x)=1, d(x,f)=2. Triangle is tight, not violated: d(x,f)=2 = d(x,t)+d(t,f)=1+1 (non-strict '>' in METRIC_TRIANGLE_FAILURE).

name: metric_identity_failure
why: d(x,x)=1; all other x-distances 1; no triple violates (1 > 1+1 is false).

name: metric_degenerate_triangle_probe
why: d(x,x)=1 > d(x,f)+d(f,x)=1/4+1/4: the only violating triple has l=r=x.

name: metric_pseudometric
why: d(f,x)=d(x,f)=0 with f != x; d(x,t)=1; triangle holds everywhere.

name: metric_not_total_suppresses_axioms
why: Entry (x,x) missing; a 1/4-shortcut triangle violation is also present but suppressed. Loss pairs over {f,t} all have metric entries, so no METRIC_LOSS_DOMAIN_MISMATCH.

name: metric_false_vs_zero_canonical_distinct
why: Values [false,true,0]: distinct as canonical JSON ('false' vs '0'); discrete metric. An implementation using host-language equality (False == 0) would instead emit DUPLICATE_METRIC_VALUE / DUPLICATE_METRIC_ENTRY codes (not machine-checked here).

name: duplicate_metric_value
why: values [false,true,false]; product over the declared set is still covered.

name: reference_missing_case
why: Only case.zero weighted (weight 1): sums to 1 but case.one undeclared (zero mass must be explicit, S21 item 2).

name: loss_differs_from_metric
why: loss(false,true)=2 while d(false,true)=1.

name: loss_extra_entry_not_total
why: Extra loss row (truth 'x', action false) outside range x actions; value equals the (discrete) metric so no per-pair code under either iteration reading.

name: stage2_accumulation_order
why: One defect of each Stage 2 family; sequence must follow Stage 2 order.

name: stage2_masks_candidates_and_frontier
why: Reference defect plus a non-probability decoder and a false feasible claim: Gate 2 returns before candidates/frontier.

name: decoder_float_probability
why: probability 0.5 as a JSON number.

name: decoder_decimal_string
why: probability '0.5' as a decimal string.

name: decoder_negative_probability
why: '-1/2' and '3/2' in one row (sum 1). The schema pattern forbids a sign, so the 'negative entry' clause of DECODER_NOT_PROBABILITY is unreachable post-schema.

name: tolerance_float
why: tolerance 0.5 as a JSON number (hash recomputed so only the schema defect remains).

name: decoder_sum_one_minus_1e-17_exact
why: 99999999999999999/10^17 + 0 != 1 exactly (binary64 would round it to 1.0).

name: near_exact_decoder_is_not_exact
why: Row sums to exactly 1 with 10^-17 on the wrong action: L(case.zero)=10^-17 > 0, so 'exact' is feasible but not exact; exact-recovery set is empty.

name: decoder_nonreduced_fractions_accept
cite: SCHEMA pattern admits '2/4'; S21 exact rationals
why: '2/4','2/4' and '0/7'-style values are exact 1/2 and 0; record otherwise equals fixture.

name: decoder_unknown_action_positive
why: r0 -> {false:1/2, 'abstain':1/2}; full row sums to 1.

name: decoder_unknown_action_zero_probability_probe
why: Exact candidate adds {'abstain': '0'}; whether an explicit zero is an 'assignment' is open.

name: tolerance_boundary_float_trap_accept
cite: S21 'feasible exactly when aggregate is at most tolerance'

name: tolerance_strict_misread
why: Claims computed with strict '<' at tol 1/2: feasible {exact} only. Recomputed: feasible {randomized, exact, dominated}, Pareto {randomized, exact}, least {}.

name: cost_ties_two_least_accept
cite: S21 'below ... no greater on every coordinate'; least
why: A,B exact with equal cost (2,2); C randomized (3,3). Pareto {A,B}; least {A,B} (preorder: ties are mutually below); exact {A,B}.

name: cost_ties_claim_no_least
why: Same as cost_ties_two_least_accept but claims no least element (uniqueness assumed).

name: incomparable_lexicographic_least_claim
why: Fixture with least claimed ['randomized'] (storage-first lexicographic scalarization).

name: cost_order_permuted_accept
why: randomized lists costs as [evaluation=3, storage=1]. Keyed reading: (1,3), fixture result. A positional reader would get (3,1), tie with exact, making both least -> LEAST_SET_MISMATCH.

name: infeasible_cheap_candidate_least_probe
cite: S21 'A least element must be below every feasible candidate'
why: Add cheap_wrong (0,0) with r0->true, r1->false: E=1 > 1/2, infeasible. Pareto ignores it (dominance only by feasible candidates). Least over feasible is empty.

name: fixture_under_maximum_aggregation
cite: S21 aggregate max_x L_d(x); RESULTS 'observably different'
why: aggregation=maximum: dominated has max(0,1)=1 > 1/2, infeasible; Pareto {randomized, exact}, least {}, exact {exact} unchanged.

name: zero_mass_expected_support_relative_accept
why: mu=(1,0), tol 0, expected: dominated E=1*0+0*1=0 -> feasible and exact on support; randomized E=1/2. feasible=exact={exact,dominated}; Pareto=least={exact}.

name: zero_mass_full_domain_exact_claim
cite: S21 'zero-mass cases ... cannot be inferred from a zero aggregate'
why: As above but claims exact recovery = {exact} (full-domain inference). No ZERO_TOLERANCE_EXACT_BOUNDARY_FAILURE: the recomputed sets agree; only the claim is wrong.

name: zero_mass_under_maximum
cite: S21 §Exact boundary: maximum inspects every case
why: mu=(1,0), tol 0, maximum: dominated max loss 1 -> infeasible, not exact. Claims copied from the expected-aggregation reading.

name: collision_zero_tolerance_vacuous_least_probe
why: r(case.zero)=r(case.one)=r0 with different beta: every decoder has E=1/2. tol 0 -> feasible = exact = Pareto = least = {} (all claims empty).

name: collision_maximum_randomization_accept
why: maximum, tol 1/2: always_false/always_true have max loss 1; coin has max 1/2 -> the randomized decoder is the unique feasible, Pareto and least candidate; exact {}.

name: collision_maximum_expected_claims
why: Same record, claims computed under expected aggregation (all feasible; always_false least).

name: duplicate_candidate_skips_its_errors
why: 4th candidate reuses id 'exact' and has a 3/4-sum row; skipped, so no DECODER_NOT_PROBABILITY.

name: candidate_errors_accumulate
why: randomized lacks 'evaluation'; dominated r1 row sums to 1/2.

name: decoder_coverage_masks_frontier
why: exact lacks the r1 row; a false 'ghost' feasible claim is not reported (Gate 4).

name: decoder_extra_unused_representation
why: exact adds a row for unused representation value r2.

name: claim_unknown_candidate_id
why: claimed_feasible includes non-existent 'ghost'.

name: freeze_hash_masks_decoder_error
why: tolerance changed without re-hashing, plus a non-probability decoder row.

name: draft_contract
why: freeze.status DRAFT with null time/hash (schema-valid).

name: outcome_refuted
why: report.outcome REFUTED with approximation_cost evidence.

name: mode_exact
why: contract.mode = exact (approximation block retained).

name: representation_declared
why: representation.status = DECLARED.

name: behavior_missing_case
why: required_behavior table omits case.one (representation still complete).
